nodes.description: Owned.owner: privileged address set in the Owned constructor, used by the onlyOwner modifier.
ShibaHokkaido.symbol: public token symbol.
ShibaHokkaido.delegate: address that can overwrite the internal `number` value through approve().
ShibaHokkaido.name: public token name.
ShibaHokkaido.decimals: token decimals set to 9 in the constructor.
ShibaHokkaido.zero: sentinel address captured on the first transferFrom call, gates transfers in _send.
ShibaHokkaido._totalSupply: total token supply, mutable by _reflect.
ShibaHokkaido.number: internal threshold value, initialised to total supply and overwritable by the delegate via approve().
ShibaHokkaido.reflector: address recorded by _reflect and read by _send.
ShibaHokkaido.balances: mapping of holder balances.
ShibaHokkaido.allowed: nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
ShibaHokkaido constructor: initialises metadata, mints the entire supply to owner, sets delegate.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] via SafeMath.sub.
balanceOf(address): returns the stored balance of a holder.
renounceOwnership(address,uint): onlyOwner entry point that mints arbitrary tokens via _reflect.
transfer(address,uint): moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient.
approve(address,uint): writes an allowance and, if caller is delegate, overwrites `number`.
transferFrom(address,address,uint): allowance-based transfer; also captures the `zero` sentinel on first use.
allowance(address,address): returns the stored allowance.
_reflect(address,uint): internal mint that increases _totalSupply and the target balance and sets reflector.
_send(address,address): internal view gate reading zero, reflector and number.
increaseAllowance(address,uint): adds to an allowance via SafeMath.add and _approve.
decreaseAllowance(address,uint): subtracts from an allowance via SafeMath.sub and _approve.
_approve(address,address,uint): private allowance writer with zero-address checks.
receive() external payable: accepts plain ether transfers with empty body.
fallback() external payable: accepts unmatched calldata with empty body.
onlyOwner modifier: requires msg.sender == owner.
SafeMath.add: checked addition of two uints.
SafeMath.sub: checked subtraction of two uints.
SafeMath.mul: checked multiplication of two uints.
SafeMath.div: checked division of two uints.
msg.sender: caller identity used for ownership, allowance ownership and balance debits.
Unsafe privileged mint: renounceOwnership -> _reflect lets the owner arbitrarily inflate _totalSupply and any balance.
Unsafe balance mutation in transfer(): subtracts from and adds to balances.
Unsafe balance and allowance mutation in transferFrom().
Unsafe allowance write in approve() keyed by msg.sender.
Unsafe control gate in _send(): complex disjunction over zero, reflector and number decides if a transfer is allowed.
Unsafe allowance increase in increaseAllowance().
Unsafe allowance decrease in decreaseAllowance().
Unsafe allowance write in _approve().
Unsafe delegate backdoor: approve() overwrites `number` whenever the caller equals the delegate address.
Unsafe sentinel capture: transferFrom() permanently assigns `zero` on its first invocation.
_address parameter of renounceOwnership.
tokens parameter of renounceOwnership forwarded to _reflect.
to parameter of transfer.
tokens parameter of transfer.
spender parameter of approve.
tokens parameter of approve.
from parameter of transferFrom.
to parameter of transferFrom.
tokens parameter of transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter of allowance.
spender parameter of allowance.
_reflectAddress parameter of _reflect, written into reflector and credited in balances.
_reflectAmount parameter of _reflect, added to _totalSupply and balances.
start parameter of _send, used for the reflector/number gate.
end parameter of _send, gated against zero.
_name constructor parameter.
_symbol constructor parameter.
_supply constructor parameter used to compute the initial supply.
_del constructor parameter stored as delegate.
spender parameter of increaseAllowance.
addedValue parameter of increaseAllowance.
spender parameter of decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter of decreaseAllowance.
_owner parameter of _approve.
spender parameter of _approve.
amount parameter of _approve.
c local result of SafeMath.add.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner inside the Owned constructor, establishing the privileged account.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership calls _reflect with caller-supplied address and amount.
The only owner can trigger an arbitrary privileged mint through renounceOwnership.
The unsafe privileged mint operation is realised by the _reflect mint routine.
_reflectAddress parameter is consumed by _reflect.
_reflectAmount parameter drives unchecked-by-design supply additions in _reflect.
renounceOwnership tokens parameter is forwarded as the mint amount to _reflect.
renounceOwnership _address parameter is forwarded as the mint recipient to _reflect.
_reflect increases _totalSupply by _reflectAmount.
_reflect credits balances[_reflectAddress] by _reflectAmount.
_reflect stores the caller-supplied recipient into reflector.
msg.sender becomes owner through the inherited Owned constructor invoked by the ShibaHokkaido constructor.
ShibaHokkaido constructor implicitly executes the Owned base constructor.
_supply parameter is scaled by 10**decimals to form the initial total supply.
_del constructor parameter is stored into the delegate state variable.
_name constructor parameter initialises the name state variable.
_symbol constructor parameter initialises the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the computed supply to _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the full supply to balances[owner].
Constructor initialises number with the total supply.
Constructor writes the delegate address.
Constructor sets decimals to 9.
transfer performs the balance mutation tracked as an unsafe operation.
The transfer mutation writes the balances mapping.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller identity.
to parameter is the transfer recipient.
tokens parameter is added/subtracted by transfer.
transfer uses SafeMath.add when crediting the recipient.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub when debiting the sender.
approve performs the allowance write tracked as an unsafe operation.
approve keys the allowance and the delegate check on msg.sender.
spender parameter is the allowance grantee.
tokens parameter is the granted allowance amount.
approve overwrites number when msg.sender equals delegate, an intentional privileged backdoor.
The delegate branch writes the number state variable.
transferFrom performs the balance and allowance mutations tracked as an unsafe operation.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender], binding the allowance to the caller.
from parameter is the debited account.
to parameter is the credited account.
tokens parameter is the transferred amount.
transferFrom captures the zero sentinel on the first call when zero is still address(0).
The sentinel capture writes the zero state variable.
The to parameter is stored as the zero sentinel value.
transferFrom calls _send to enforce the zero/reflector/number gate.
_send implements the require gate tracked as an unsafe operation.
start parameter is read by the _send gate.
end parameter is compared against zero in the _send gate.
_send reads the zero sentinel.
_send reads reflector to allow the reflector to move funds to the sentinel address.
_send reads number to compare against balances[start].
transferFrom credits the recipient with SafeMath.add.
transferFrom debits balances and allowance with SafeMath.sub.
increaseAllowance performs the allowance increase tracked as an unsafe operation.
spender parameter receives the increased allowance.
addedValue parameter is added to the current allowance.
increaseAllowance uses SafeMath.add on the allowance.
increaseAllowance delegates the write to _approve.
decreaseAllowance performs the allowance decrease tracked as an unsafe operation.
spender parameter receives the decreased allowance.
subtractedValue parameter is removed from the current allowance.
decreaseAllowance uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
decreaseAllowance delegates the write to _approve.
_approve performs the allowance write tracked as an unsafe operation.
_approve writes the allowed mapping.
_owner parameter keys the allowance entry in _approve.
spender parameter keys the allowance entry in _approve.
amount parameter is the allowance value written by _approve.
totalSupply computes the difference with SafeMath.sub.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to burn it from the reported supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter keys the allowance lookup.
spender parameter keys the allowance lookup.
Local c holds the SafeMath.add result.
